projects.title: Projects
projects.panel.title: Projects
projects.panel.empty: No projects yet. Create one, drop sessions into it, and stop restating the background.
projects.settings.hint: Project metadata and content files stay local; no remote repository is written.
projects.menu.empty: No projects yet — create one in the Projects panel first
projects.detail.threadsEmpty: No sessions belong to this project yet. Use “Add to project…” in a session's … menu.
projects.detail.threadPlaceholder: Describe a task for a new thread (Enter to create)
projects.detail.dirPlaceholder: Absolute path; threads create worktrees here
projects.detail.routePlaceholder: Dispatch by rule: describe the task and let rules decide
projects.settings.fallback: Allow the model to propose when no rule matches
projects.settings.dangerHint: Every switch needs your explicit consent; the plugin never turns one on by itself.
projects.settings.danger.forcePushOwnBranch.label: Allow pushing your own dsh/ branches (normal push, not force)
projects.settings.danger.forcePushOwnBranch.risk: Writes to the remote; only branches starting with dsh/. **Force push (--force) is not implemented yet** — turning this on does not enable force push.
projects.settings.danger.pushProtectedBranch.labe: Allow pushing to protected branches (not implemented yet)
projects.settings.danger.pushProtectedBranch.risk: No execution path exists in this version, so turning it on has no effect; the key is kept for future alignment.
projects.settings.danger.autoMerge.label: auto-merge PRs
projects.settings.danger.autoMerge.risk: merging is irreversible (revert only); still gated by diff limits and human approval
projects.settings.danger.trashAuto.label: auto archive/delete into trash
projects.settings.danger.trashAuto.risk: moves content into trash/; restorable from manifest, but not free
projects.settings.danger.purgeAfterRetention.labe: Allow purging the trash after retention (not implemented yet)
projects.settings.danger.purgeAfterRetention.risk: No execution path exists in this version, so turning it on has no effect; the trash is never emptied automatically.
projects.settings.danger.editProfile.label: edit project policy itself
projects.settings.danger.editProfile.risk: the coordinator could loosen its own limits; highest risk
